definitions.explanation: To give money in exchange for goods or services.

examples.japanese: {料金|りょうきん}を{支払|しはら}う。
クレジットカードで{支払|しはら}う。

notes:
{支払|しはら}う means to pay.

SIMILAR:
- {支払|しはら}う: to pay (formal)
- {払|はら}う: to pay (general)

COLLOCATIONS:
- {支払|しはら}い: payment (noun)
- {支払|しはら}い{方法|ほうほう}: payment method
